title: 1930 United States Federal Census – Adam Kramer and Snead Webster Families
location: Ward 4, Baltimore City, Maryland, United States
description: The 1930 United States Federal Census records Adam Kramer (age 26) and his wife Sue Kramer (age 26) on lines 18–19. The following household, on lines 20–22, includes Snead Webster (age 58), Charles Webster (age 21), and Wilson Webster (age 10). Snead Webster was William Gabriel Snead Webster, father of Sue, Charles, and Wilson. The households were enumerated in Ward 4 of Baltimore City, Maryland, Enumeration District 4-232, Sheet 6A. The census records Sue as age 26, although her reported birth date of October 22, 1902, would make her 27 at the time of enumeration.

title: 1993 Virginia Death Certificate – Sue C. Kramer
location: Falls Church, Fairfax County, Virginia, United States
description: Commonwealth of Virginia Certificate of Death for Sue C. Kramer, who died on January 1, 1993, at Fairfax Hospital in Falls Church, Fairfax County, Virginia, at age 90. The certificate records her birth as October 22, 1902, in Maryland. Her father is identified as Gabriel Seneed and her mother as Addie Daniels, preserving the spellings recorded on the certificate. These names correspond to Gabriel Snead Webster and Addie Leola Daniel in the family archive. Her marital status is recorded as widowed, and Adam Kramer is named as her spouse. The certificate identifies Woodlawn Cemetery in Baltimore, Maryland, as her burial location. Bette Singletary is listed as the informant.

title: 1929 Commemorative Marriage Certificate – Adam Kramer and Sue C. Webster
description: Decorative marriage certificate commemorating the marriage of Adam Kramer of Baltimore, Maryland, and Sue C. Webster of Baltimore, Maryland, on July 27, 1929. This certificate corroborates the marriage date and officiant recorded on the separate official marriage certificate.
